required_evidence_unmet: Manufacturer-verifiable original DUT identity and physical possession
Independently authenticated reference certificate and traceability
Independent reference and bench ancestry with shared-root exclusion
Original raw acquisition bytes linked to hardware and source identity
Authenticated calibrated hardware clock with contiguous counters
Same-path injection and response with traceable uncertainty
Original physical drift and alarm issuance and response traces
Independent external confirmation of evidence provenance and acceptance bounds

synthetic_results.note: These are software-only tests and cannot qualify physical hardware.

freeze_semantics: Append-only historical documentary decision. Git repository mutability and future revisions are not technologically prohibited.
reopening_requirements: New, independently authenticated original physical evidence and separate authorized evaluation; do not alter frozen historical decision.
